journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu lacks a focusout handler to close when focus leaves the menu, so tabbing out of the navigation does not close the dropdown.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout event listener to the menu element that checks if the related target is outside the menu; if so, blur the menu, close children, and close the controller (if present), mirroring the click-outside logic.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When focus leaves the navigation (e.g., tabbing to the search input), the Shop dropdown will close, ensuring aria-expanded becomes false and the dropdown is hidden, meeting the expectation that tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown.
functional_risks: Potential premature closure if focus temporarily moves to a descendant outside the menu during widget interactions.
Risk of interfering with custom widgets that deliberately move focus outside the menu.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from the shop button to the search input closes the dropdown (aria-expanded false, plants hidden).
Escape key still closes the dropdown and returns focus to the shop button.
Clicking outside the menu still closes it.
Keyboard navigation within the open menu (arrow keys, Tab) works without closing the dropdown.
Space/Enter on the shop button still toggles the dropdown.

attempts.failure: Candidate build failed: [{"file":"src/disclosureMenu.js","pass":false,"kind":"syntax","message":"JavaScript syntax check failed"}]

plan.root_cause: The disclosureMenu.js file contains multiple syntax errors: the _validate method incorrectly uses the return value of isValidType (which throws rather than returns), the _handleClick method has an invalid condition (!this.dom.menu !== event.target), and the initialize method lacks a focusout handler to close the dropdown when focus leaves the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Fix the three syntax errors in disclosureMenu.js: 1) Correct _validate to catch errors from isValidType. 2) Fix the click-outside condition to only check containment. 3) Add a _handleFocusBlur method and call it from initialize so that tabbing out of the navigation closes the dropdown.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When focus leaves the navigation (e.g., tabbing to the search input), the Shop dropdown will close, ensuring aria-expanded becomes false and the dropdown is hidden, meeting the expectation that tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown.
functional_risks: Potential premature closure if focus temporarily moves to a descendant outside the menu during widget interactions.
Risk of interfering with custom widgets that deliberately move focus outside the menu.

Escape key still closes the dropdown and returns focus to the shop button.
